claims.claim: Identity and tradability validated for Parker-Hannifin Corporation, NYSE:PH, CIK 0000076334.
FY2026 10-K/results and Filtration Group close are primary sources; current valuation is separately sourced and issuer duplicates are not counted as independent corroboration.

risks.risk: Acquisition integration and rich valuation can reduce realized returns.

claims.claim: FY26 sales rose 8.3% to $21.5B, organic sales 6.6%, adjusted net income 16%, and Q4 adjusted segment margin reached 28.0%.
Filtration Group integration and the FY31 30% adjusted segment margin target are material forward catalysts, not achieved outcomes.

thesisQuality.basis: Record FY26 sales, organic growth, margin expansion and broad critical applications support durable demand/value capture.

catalystScore.basis: Filtration integration and FY31 30% adjusted segment margin target are identifiable material catalysts with prospective realization.

governancePower.basis: 70 consecutive fiscal years of dividend increases plus repeated margin and portfolio execution support strong stewardship.
